privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses case BraTS2021_00000. The enhancement ratio must be calculated as (T1ce_Tumor / T1ce_WM) / (T1_Tumor / T1_WM) or similar relative metric; the allowed error for the ratio is 0.3 and 25% for relative enhancement. The classification and pattern must be derived from these calculated values. The output directory is /home/ga/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/.
